description: 3D permeable-surface FW-H around a fixed sphere (6DOF, all DOFs fixed) in a uniform inflow (B 60 1), single phase, Re = 500, N40=14 (low-storage RK3, N 40 44), 4 MPI ranks. Downstream face closed by 3 averaged end caps (U 21 2, U 22 3 0.8, Shur et al. 2005). Coarse version of Regression/validation/fwh 10.
covers: acoustics_fwh with the low-storage RK3 momentum (N 40 44) and 6DOF direct forcing
U 21/U 22 end caps as panel weights
